topics.title: Doctor’s Office Phone Call Mishap
topics.summary: A frantic phone call unfolds as a man attempts to navigate medical appointments and parental concerns, repeatedly misidentifying himself and seeking advice from the school principal. The conversation becomes increasingly bizarre involving musical selections and listener participation before concluding with an advertisement for a vacation contest.

topics.title: Radio Guests and Kokomo Critique
topics.summary: During a live radio broadcast, hosts playfully critique John Phillips’s performance of ‘Kokomo,’ highlighting his off-key vocals and the Beach Boys' interest in recording it. Steve Martin reads from Carson show diary while Billy Squire performs 'Stroker,' followed by David Brenner discussing sponsorship awards.

topics.title: Bedford Hills Price Discussions & Drug Concerns
topics.summary: During a meandering conversation, callers discuss low prices at Bedford Hills and the impending sale of stock by October 1st. The discussion then shifts to concerns about David’s drug use, including cocaine swabs and attempts to profit from them, alongside debates regarding Joan Rivers' relationship with Carson Daly and opinions on abortion.

topics.title: Stern’s Frustration with Joan and Edgar
topics.summary: During the broadcast, Howard Stern expresses regret over his handling of former Fox executive Edgar Norton’s departure, lamenting a potential negotiation fallout with the network. He then criticizes talk show host Joan Rivers' continued focus on the situation, concluding that ‘the world is kind of fed up with it anyway.’

topics.title: French Toast Frustration
topics.summary: During a radio segment, hosts engage in an extended argument centered around one host’s excessive consumption of French toast. They repeatedly mock each other's behavior, including attempts to hide syrup and accusations of lying about eating habits, culminating in discussions involving Scott Muny and his record collection.

topics.title: Skid Marks, MTV Auditions & Voodoo
topics.summary: During the broadcast, hosts discuss a bizarre incident involving skid marks in someone’s shorts and then Gary attempts to secure an audition for MTV's news show. They also delve into rumors surrounding Mayor Marion Barry’s alleged drug use, including details of suppositories used as cocaine delivery.
